def test_intersection():
    # Overlapping intervals with prime intersection length
    assert intersection((1, 5), (2, 8)) == "YES"       # length = 3 (prime)
    assert intersection((3, 9), (1, 6)) == "YES"       # length = 3 (prime)
    assert intersection((1, 10), (5, 15)) == "YES"     # length = 5 (prime)
    assert intersection((0, 15), (2, 15)) == "YES"     # length = 13 (prime)

    # Overlapping intervals with non-prime intersection length
    assert intersection((1, 10), (2, 12)) == "NO"      # length = 8 (not prime)
    assert intersection((1, 10), (2, 6)) == "NO"       # length = 4 (not prime)
    assert intersection((1, 12), (0, 14)) == "NO"      # length = 12 (not prime)

    # One interval fully contained in another
    assert intersection((1, 10), (3, 6)) == "YES"      # length = 3 (prime)
    assert intersection((0, 100), (10, 20)) == "NO"    # length = 10 (not prime)

    # Touching intervals (length = 0)
    assert intersection((1, 2), (2, 3)) == "NO"
    assert intersection((5, 7), (7, 10)) == "NO"

    # Disjoint intervals
    assert intersection((1, 2), (3, 4)) == "NO"

    # Identical intervals
    assert intersection((1, 2), (1, 2)) == "NO"        # length = 1 (not prime)

    # Overlap of length 1 (not prime)
    assert intersection((-1, 1), (0, 4)) == "NO"
    # Overlap of length 2 (prime)
    assert intersection((-3, -1), (-5, 5)) == "YES"
    # Overlap of length 2 (prime)
    assert intersection((0, 4), (2, 6)) == "YES"

    assert intersection((0, 2), (2, 4)) == "NO"
    # Overlap of length 3 (prime)

    # Overlap of length 4 (not prime)
